heading: How To Look After Original Wood Flooring
bodyHtml:
Wood flooring can really bring a house to life, showing off a period property’s original features and helping to restore its antiquated look. Carpets can hide a house’s best fixtures, so stripping them back and showing off the original timber can highlight its period charm.

However, this is only if the flooring has been looked after well. Here are some tips on how to maintain your original floor so it can last several years more.

  • Regular maintenance

The trick to making sure wooden floorboards look good, even after decades, is to take care of them regularly. This includes wiping away spills immediately so no stains are allowed to soak into the wood. This also prevents water damage, such as warping, from occurring.

It is also important to sweep or vacuum the floor at least twice a week, according to Real Simple, to get rid of any dust and debris brought into the house. If left to accumulate, these will build up and cause a layer of dirt to form, which becomes harder to shift.

  • Protection

As well as keeping it clean, it is important to protect it from further damage. For instance, you should remove shoes – especially high heels – as these can create dents and scratches that are hard to get rid of.

You should also be careful when moving heavy furniture by picking them up instead of dragging. Having a rug in busy areas, such as hallways or in the lounge, is a good idea as well, as this will add further protection.

  • Restoring services

To really bring your floor back to life, it is a good idea to employ restoration services that can rejuvenate these period features.

By sanding a layer of wood, the top layer of dirt is removed, and any signs of wear and tear are gone for good.
